clips.title: The story
paras: At Thunder Bluff, a young Horde druid returns to claim the gift of Cure Poison. After healing poisoned gazelles near the Crossroads with herbal mixtures, the initiate faces Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.

Before granting a druid the power to cleanse venom, the Cenarion Circle asks them to learn what affliction feels like. Dendrite Starblaze sends the novice to the Crossroads, where Tonga Runetotem has them gather ingredients for a salve. The druid treats poisoned gazelles of the Barrens by hand, without spiritual aid, and sees the struggle ordinary creatures face against natural and unnatural toxins.

After the trial, Dendrite sends the initiate to Turak Runetotem, the grand druid trainer on Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise. Turak warns that strange, virulent poisons near the Crossroads threaten the plains' natural balance. He commends the initiate's grace under pressure and grants the spiritual art of curing poisons, placing Kalimdor's living creatures in their care.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've learned what it means to cure poison without the benefit of spiritual aid. Remember what others must endure in fighting poisonous afflictions as you soon embrace your newfound power over poison.
You should now return to Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff, friend. He, no doubt, has a very important spell to teach you now that the student understands the lesson given unto them.
Farewell, young druid. We shall speak again.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome back - I've been following your progress on this lesson since you left, and I must admit I was surprised to learn about the situation at the Crossroads. This does bear some further investigation, as the introduction of such poisons into the environment is most upsetting to the balance.
You handled yourself with grace under pressure. For that, I can find no better way to reward you than with permanent power over poison. Use it well, friend... Use it well.
